title: Cel Composite
description: Une esthétique mixte combinant des illustrations vectorielles plates en cel-shading superposées à des arrière-plans photographiques vibrants et haute résolution. Les éléments illustrés de premier plan présentent des contours noirs nets et des aplats de couleurs, interagissant avec l'environnement réaliste par le biais de reflets simulés.
description_en: A mixed-media aesthetic combining flat, 2D cel-shaded vector illustrations superimposed onto vibrant, high-resolution photographic backgrounds. The illustrated foreground elements feature crisp black outlines and solid color fills, interacting seamlessly with the realistic environment through simulated reflections and spatial grounding.
description_fr: Une esthétique mixte combinant des illustrations vectorielles plates en cel-shading superposées à des arrière-plans photographiques vibrants et haute résolution. Les éléments illustrés de premier plan présentent des contours noirs nets et des aplats de couleurs, interagissant avec l'environnement réaliste par le biais de reflets simulés.
prompt:
A mixed-media composite blending flat 2D vector illustration over a high-resolution photographic background. Apply this style to the complete scene described by {{subject}}, preserving its factual content, camera angle, framing, spatial layout, and stated exclusions. The primary focus elements of the scene are rendered as crisp, cel-shaded 2D illustrations featuring clean, uniform black outlines, solid {{primary_color}} fills, and hard-edged {{secondary_color}} shadows. These flat cartoon elements are superimposed onto a hyper-realistic, vividly saturated photographic environment. The background features deep depth of field, natural daylighting, and sharp photographic textures, contrasting starkly with the untextured, matte finish of the illustrated foreground. The 2D elements interact physically with the 3D environment, casting simplified {{accent_color}} reflections or shadows onto the realistic surfaces to ground them in the spatial dynamics of the scene. The photographic background exhibits a bright, cheerful color grading with vibrant, highly saturated tones, emphasizing a sunny, clear atmosphere. The illustrated components maintain a rigid vector quality, devoid of gradients, noise, or brushstrokes, relying entirely on stark boundaries between light and shadow. The crisp vector linework acts as a definitive barrier between the illustrative and photographic worlds, ensuring the two mediums remain visually distinct yet perfectly composited together. This juxtaposition creates a surreal, augmented-reality effect where playful cartoon logic invades the physical world. The image MUST occupy the absolute ENTIRE dedicated space as a canvas rule: NO borders, NO frames, NO white margins, NO canvas edges, FULL BLEED to all four corners.

The scene is bathed in bright, clear sunlight, highlighting hyper-realistic textures of nature and urban elements. Colors are highly saturated, emphasizing a cheerful atmosphere with {{primary_color}} and {{secondary_color}} tones dominating the natural and structural surfaces, while {{accent_color}} highlights catch the sunlight. video.motion: The flat 2D illustrated elements animate with crisp, keyframed, slightly stepped motion (on twos), contrasting with smooth, realistic 3D motion in the photographic background elements like flowing water or swaying trees.
video.camera: A locked-off or slowly panning tripod shot that emphasizes the surreal juxtaposition between the static background and the dynamic 2D foreground.
video.temporal_texture: The photographic background maintains photorealistic stability and a high frame rate, while the 2D elements maintain perfectly uniform black outlines and solid color fills without any rendering flicker or gradient shifts.
video.avoid: Avoid blending the 2D and 3D elements via depth-of-field blur on the cartoon characters, and avoid adding realistic shading, gradients, or 3D lighting to the flat vector elements.
